'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Blake Huffman LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Blake Huffman]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Team Stephenville presents Light Senate
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
